sn41.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Macchikāsaṇḍe viharanti Ambāṭakavane || || 2
sn41.4:1.2: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati there bhikkhū etad avoca ||
sn41.4:1.3: Adhivāsentu me therā svātanāya gokule bhattanti || ||
sn41.4:1.5: Atha kho Citto gahapati therānam bhikkhūnam adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 5
sn41.4:1.6: Atha kho therā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Cittassa gahapatino gokulaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu || || 6
sn41.4:2.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati there bhikkhū paṇītena sappipāyāsena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi || || 7
sn41.4:2.2: Atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onitapattapanino uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu || ||
sn41.4:2.3: Citto pi kho gahapati sesakam vissajjethā ti vatvā there bhikkhū piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi || || 8
sn41.4:2.4: Tena kho pana samayena uṇhaṃ hoti kuṭṭhitaṃ ||
sn41.4:2.5: te ca therā bhikkhū paveliyamānena maññe kāyena gacchanti || yathā tam bhojanaṃ bhuttāvino || || 9
sn41.4:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahako tasmim bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti || ||
sn41.4:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca || ||
sn41.4:3.3: Sādhu khvassa bhante Thera yaṃ sītako ca vāto vāyeyya abbhasaṃvilāpo ca assa devo ca ekam ekam phusāyeyyāti || ||
sn41.4:4.1: Sādhu khvassa āvuso Mahaka yaṃ sītako ca vāto vāyeyya abbhasaṃvilāpo ca assa devo ca ekam ekam phusāyeyyā ti || || 10
sn41.4:4.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako tathārūpam iddhābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkhari || yathā sītako ca vāto vāyi abbhasaṃvilāpo ca assa devo ca ekam ekam phusi || || 11
sn41.4:4.3: Atha kho Cittassa gahapatino etad ahosi ||
sn41.4:4.4: Yo kho imasmim bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako bhikkhu || tassāyam evarūpo iddhānubhāvo ti || || 12
sn41.4:4.5: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako ārāmaṃ sampāpuṇitvā āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca ||
sn41.4:4.10: Atha kho therā bhikkhū yathāvihāram agamaṃsu || ||
sn41.4:4.11: Āyasmā pi Mahako sakaṃ vihāram agamāsi || || 14
sn41.4:5.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati yenāyasmā Mahako tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Mahakam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || 15 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati āyasmantam Mahakam etad avoca || ||
sn41.4:5.2: Sādhu me bhante ayyo Mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetūti || ||
sn41.4:5.3: Tena hi tvam gahapati āḷinde uttarāsaṅgam paññāpetvā tiṇakalāpam okāsehīti || ||
sn41.4:5.4: Evam bhante ti kho Citto gahapati āyasmato Mahakassa paṭissutvā āḷinde uttarāsaṅgam paññāpetvā tiṇakalāpam okāsesi || 16
sn41.4:5.5: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako vihāram pavisitvā sucighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpam iddhābhisaṅkhāram abhisaṅkhari || yathā tāḷacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷantarikāya ca acchi nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi uttarāsaṅgaṃ na jhāpesi || || 17
sn41.4:5.6: Atha kho Citto gahapati uttarāsaṅgam pappoṭetvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 18
sn41.4:5.7: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako vihārā nikkhamitvā Cittam gahapatim etad avoca ||
sn41.4:6.6: aham ayyassa Mahakassa ussukkaṃ karissāmi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-senāsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānan ti || ||
sn41.4:6.8: Atha kho āyasmā Mahako senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Macchikāsaṇḍamhā pakkāmi ||
sn41.4:6.9: yam Macchikāsaṇḍamhā pakkāmi tathā pakkanto va ahosi
